s1.syndrome_frame: Acute respiratory illness with fever and shortness of breath
salient_findings: Fever up to 39°C
Anosmia
Shortness of breath
Oxygen saturation of 85% on room air
Coarse rales at the lung bases bilaterally
Bilateral multifocal pneumonia on chest radiography
key_facts: Oxygen saturation of 85% on room air
Coarse rales at the lung bases bilaterally
Nasopharyngeal swab positive by reverse transcriptase–polymerase chain reaction
Chest radiography suggestive of bilateral multifocal pneumonia
Normal sinus rhythm with normal frontal QRS axis on ECG

rejected.label: obstructive sleep apnea
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of obstructive sleep apnea, the current presentation is more consistent with an acute infectious process

rejected.label: obesity
rejected.why: Morbid obesity is a comorbidity, but it does not directly explain the acute symptoms of fever, anosmia, and shortness of breath

rejected.label: systemic lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: There is no evidence of autoimmune symptoms or findings suggestive of systemic lupus erythematosus in the vignette

rejected.label: chronic obstructive pulmonary disease
rejected.why: The patient's symptoms and findings are more consistent with an acute infectious process rather than a chronic obstructive lung disease
